refill.why: Grammatical, but only one BUILD is needed and B01 is the stronger, more natural pairing.
'be' ydy'r ateb heddiw' (what the answer is today) is an odd fragment with no natural use.
'efo fi' after 'dyfalu be' ydy'r ateb' reads awkwardly, and 나와 is ambiguous: it could mean 'with me' or 'me and', so the Korean allows more than one Welsh answer.
